messages:
Alex: FYI SRE + Product want a single console view: per-route latency (P50/P95/P99), quota burn rate, and traffic split by model_variant. Can Eng-Platform + Runtime add exporter fields for this?
Maria: big ask but doable. question: do we emit route as free-form tag or route_id? cardinality concerns if route names are arbitrary.
Jing: runtime can add tags: route, model_variant, quota_tier from request metadata. cheap to emit but series count skyrockets for high-cardinality routes.
Sam: for dashboards we aggregate to 5m then 1h. route+variant multiplies series. options: sampling, hashing, or namespace-level aggregation.
Amy: ops note: quota_tier is low-cardinality (free/prod/enterprise) keep it. route is user-defined and high-cardinality.
Alex: proposal: exporter emits route tag but we store two retention tiers: full-granularity hot for 7d and aggregated longer-term. console shows hot per-route heatmaps; long-term shows aggregated trends.
Maria: +1 two-tier retention. UI should show when values are sampled/aggregated (e.g., "sampled view"). UX must surface sampling rate.
Jing: implementation sketch:
```
metrics.emit(name="inference.latency", value=lat_ms, tags={"route": rt, "model_variant": mv, "quota_tier": qt})
// set X-Metrics-Sample-Rate header
```
We can add header so clients can opt-out of sampling.
Sam: aggregation windows suggestions: hot=30s, mid=5m, cold=1h. Cost tradeoff. 30s gives nicer UX but doubles ingestion.
Amy: SRE prefers 1m for hot to reduce storage spike. 1m is a reasonable compromise.
Alex: agree: hot=1m retention 7d, mid=5m retention 90d, cold=1h retention 365d (aggregated).
Maria: product asked for 180d per-route trends in console. if raw granularity kept only 7d, backfill for older per-route data requires rebuilding from raw logs -> expensive.
ops-bot: deploy-stats: new exporter schema validated on staging — 3 warnings about tag length.
Jing: avoid free-form route strings as metric tags. suggestion: use hashed route -> route_id tag; keep route_name in separate metadata lookup service. hashing reduces cardinality risk and keeps tags compact.
Sam: hashed route_id helps but route_id+model_variant still creates many combinations. for mid/cold we should pre-aggregate by route_namespace when available.
Amy: proposed retention policy for review:
- raw metrics (route_id, mv, qt) @1m retained 7d
- aggregated by route_namespace+mv @5m retained 90d
- global aggregates + mv @1h retained 365d
- ad-hoc raw backfills up to 30d require cost approval
Maria: +1 but product wants 180d. need cost estimate and owner for that ask.
Alex: finance + eng-platform will estimate. Sam, can you spike to estimate storage/cost for 180d per-route raw metrics?
Sam: will run a spike on last 30d and extrapolate. ETA EOD Thu.
ops-bot: reminder — quota dashboard prototype demo tomorrow 10:30 PT.
Jing: open question: add deployment_shard tag to relate latency to placement/routing policy? Useful for incidents.
Amy: ok to include deployment_shard but optional; set only for Dedicated/Private to avoid inflating hosted traffic cardinality.
Alex: decision summary to record here: exporter emits route_id (hashed) + model_variant + quota_tier + optional deployment_shard; add X-Metrics-Sample-Rate header; retention: raw 7d@1m, aggregated 90d@5m, global 365d@1h; route_name stored in metadata lookup; backfills >30d require cost approval and spike for 180d cost.
Maria: I'll update telemetry design doc + console UX notes to show "sampled/aggregated" badges and sampling rate.
Jing: I'll open exporter PR with feature flag; will run 2-week staging rollout.
Sam: spike started, will post numbers to this thread.
Amy: I'll coordinate with SRE on ingestion windows and shard sizing; will add retention config to infra repo.
ops-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-432 add telemetry fields; owner=Jing; due=2026-04-02
ops-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-433 backfill-cost-estimate; owner=Sam; due=2026-03-26
Alex: thanks team. demo tomorrow + keep sync. :thumbsup:
